body: Full rubric in RFC-0062 OQ-6 resolution (2026-11-06). The systems (autonomy policies, enforcement levels) have about ten boolean inputs. The only production SMT-over-policy precedent (AWS Zelkova) is hosted, never shipped to clients; OPA, Conftest, Checkov ship no solver. z3-solver on npm adds 25 to 30 MB and a new supply-chain surface to a CLI whose trust chain is being tightened.
